prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Redesigning the sign_in page for clarity and account sync status was helpful (+8.0% win) and accurately predicted.
Redesigning the finish page showed no clear effect (-8.3%, p=0.106), and predictions (+7.0%) were too high.
Adding wait_info tips on the home page showed no clear effect (-2.1%, p=0.454), and predictions (+5.0%) were too high.
Changing the layout on choose_path showed no clear effect (+1.5%, p=0.422), and predictions (+5.0%) were too high.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- choose_path, layout: +1.5% over 1 test(s)
- finish, redesign: -8.3% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: -2.1% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, redesign: +8.0% over 1 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 76.8%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 18.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Interactive Pet Selection Split Layout: Redesign the pet selection screen into a split view with live animated pet previews and distinct choice cards. (why: Adoption conversion is low (60.9%) with custom generation bugs and high decision time (mean 1017s).)
1: [adoption, new_screen] Custom Pet Visual Verification Screen: Add a new confirmation step after photo upload to preview and verify custom pet rendering before adoption. (why: Support receives tickets about custom pets failing or looking wrong after photo upload.)
2: [home, new_flow] Animated Stage Waiting Flow: Transform the waiting screen into a interactive stage layout with time estimates and mascot animation. (why: The home waiting step takes a median of 201s and mean 2336s, leading to drop-off or suspected app freezing.)
3: [choose_path, reorder] Bond First Sign In Later Reorder: Move sign-in after picking a pet companion so users form an emotional connection before account creation. (why: Early drop-off is high, and letting users choose their pet before account setup increases intent.)
4: [adoption, copy] Photo Upload Quality Guidance: Add clear instructions on photo lighting and single-subject framing on the photo upload screen. (why: Users report failed or distorted custom pet renders during adoption.)
5: [finish, hint] Desktop Controls Quick Reference Hint: Add explicit usage hints on the finish screen explaining how to summon, hide, and right-click the pet. (why: 3 support emails report confusion about how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after onboarding.)
6: [choose_path, copy] Flexible Path Choice Assurance Copy: Add explicit reassurance copy that chosen path options can be changed later in app settings. (why: High mean time on choose_path (514s) indicates hesitation due to fear of permanent commitment.)

scores.note: Adoption has high drop-off and long duration, but layout redesigns showed mixed results in past tests.
Both funnel drop-off and support tickets point to custom pet issues, but adding a new screen increases friction.
Home step wait tips previously failed to produce positive lift (-2.1%), making flow overhauls risky.
Targeting early funnel drop-off by deferring sign-in can boost intent, though it requires significant structural changes.
Strong evidence from support emails and funnel data; low-cost copy guidance can directly resolve pet render failures.
Addresses explicit support feedback via low-cost hints, though finish screen changes showed weak results previously.
Addresses high hesitation time (514s) on choose_path with a simple, low-cost copy update.
